# Getting support

Choose the right place so your question or report reaches the right people.

## Questions and ideas

For usage questions, help understanding expected behavior, or general ideas, start a
[GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/rakeshnitb23/toolism/discussions). Please use
discussions for questions rather than opening an issue.

## Bug reports

If you have found a reproducible bug in toolism, open a
[bug report](https://github.com/rakeshnitb23/toolism/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
Include a minimal tool definition and the relevant command or code when possible.

## Security vulnerabilities

Please report security vulnerabilities privately through the
[GitHub security advisory form](https://github.com/rakeshnitb23/toolism/security/advisories/new).
Do not disclose vulnerabilities in public issues or discussions. See
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the security policy and reporting details.

## Contributing

If you would like to contribute code, documentation, or tests, please read
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the development setup, checks, and pull request
guidelines.
